# Helper: search contacts with pagination

def search_contacts_all(query, relationship=None):
    out=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=query, relationship=relationship, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)

    page_index=0
    while True:
        res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        if not res:
            break
        out.extend(res)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index > 50:
            break
    return out

def is_about_reunion(text):
    tl = (text or '').lower()
    return ('reunion' in tl) or ('party' in tl) or ('jun' in tl) or ('06' in tl) or ('07' in tl)


def parse_rsvp(text):
    tl=(text or '').lower()

    # hard negative patterns
    neg = [
        r"\bnot coming\b",
        r"\bnot going\b",
        r"\bmiss\b",
        r"\boother commitments\b", # typo guard
        r"\bother commitments\b",
        r"\bcan't\b",
        r"\bcannot\b",
        r"\bcan\s*not\b",
        r"\bwon\s*'t\b",
        r"\bwon\s*t\b",
        r"\bwont\b",
        r"\bcan't join\b",
        r"\bcan\s*not\s*join\b",
        r"\bnot\s+join\b",
    ]

    pos = [
        r"\byes\b",
        r"\babsolutely\b",
        r"\bsure\b",
        r"\bi\s*('m|am)\s*coming\b",
        r"\bi\s*('ll| will)\s*be\b",
        r"\b(i\s*('ll be| will be)|i\s*('m|am))\s*at\b",
        r"\bi\s*will\s*be\s*at\b",
        r"\bI'll\s*be\s*at\b",
        r"\bcoming\b",
        r"\bbe\s*at\b",
        r"\blooking forward\b",
    ]

    # if both pos and neg present, negative wins only if explicit can't/cannot/not
    for pat in neg:
        if re.search(pat, tl):
            return 'no'
    for pat in pos:
        if re.search(pat, tl):
            return 'yes'
    return 'unknown'
